summary: 1 Band A item: Shire hazardous-waste and bin-fire safety warning; human editorial review required.

actToday.title: Bin fires put residents and drivers at risk
actToday.description: The Shire says a series of fires this winter has highlighted the danger hazardous items create for waste-truck drivers and the community. The release was published 17 August.
actToday.interpretation: Useful safety information, but retain the Shire's factual wording and verify any disposal guidance directly before publication.
actToday.recommendation: Telegram PI group and safety/hub update, subject to human editorial approval.

news.item: Community and Council unite to finish Flinders pier restoration
news.note: The Shire says 13 wooden piles remain offshore after an unfinished State Government restoration project. Treat as a fact-checked heritage/infrastructure watch item; political sensitivity requires a human editorial call.

news.item: Illegal dumpers fined after Shire investigations
news.note: The Shire says enforcement officers issued fines after investigations into unlawful dumping and littering. Bank for a practical waste-disposal explainer.
The Shire is seeking input while finalising its kindergarten-infrastructure review. Use only as a neutral consultation diary item.

news.item: Portsea named Victorian Top Tourism Town winner
news.note: The Shire says Portsea won the Tiny Tourism Town category in the 2026 Victorian Top Tourism Town Awards and is a national finalist. Confirm award details before a destination-profile mention.
